name: Tsundere
source:
I present to you folks... Tsundere VN!

Content warning:
Some foul language (but only if you're a jerk and get one of the many bad endings).
Terrible game.

It's 417 words of pure, poorly written TSUNDERE FANSERVICE!

[Edited from [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?p=209012#p209012/]renai.us[/url]]

各位請看……傲嬌視覺小說，登場！

內容提醒：
有幾句髒話（前提是你非要當個混蛋，打出眾多壞結局中的一個）。
